segment.description: Tennessee River main stem, West Tennessee reach as cataloged (regionId tn-west): the river's impounded main-stem reach from Pickwick Lake north to the Kentucky line — the Kentucky Lake pool of the Tennessee River (the river legitimately leaves Tennessee between mile 424 at Shellmound upstream and Pickwick). Warm main-stem water: TWRA documents the reach's famous winter SAUGER run (a warmwater percids fish, not a trout), and the catalog notes the trout fishing lives in the separate cold tailwaters below the dams.
segment.boundaries: Main-stem reach within West Tennessee from Pickwick Lake to the Kentucky line (hydroIdentity GNIS 00517033, HUC8 06040001; catalog counties: Hardin). USGS mainstem stations in the reach: 03593500 Tennessee River at Savannah (Kentucky Lake pool, Hardin County) and 03594500 Tennessee River at Perryville (Decatur County).

coldSource.notes: The reach is a TVA mainstem reservoir pool (Kentucky Lake) bounded by mainstem dams, not a trout tailwater; evidenceUrl documents TWRA's description of this TVA mainstream water, its pool range (354-359 ft MSL), and the sauger fishery on the downstream side of TVA dams. No cold-release regime documented for this reach; no trout fishery of any kind is documented.

holdover.detail: No trout fishery of any kind is documented on the main stem: no Kentucky Lake/Kentucky/Tennessee River row appears anywhere on TWRA's 2026 trout stocking schedule (full-page scan; 616-row workbook), the mainstem reservoirs are absent from the TWRA Trout Management Plan's list of nine trout reservoirs, and TWRA's documented main-stem fishery is warmwater (sauger run December to March below TVA dams like Pickwick Dam; largemouth bass the dominant harvest).

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout documented. TWRA's Trout Management Plan states 'Wild trout are generally limited to East Tennessee's mountain streams'; TWRA's documented main-stem species (Kentucky Reservoir page) are entirely warmwater with no trout.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: Warm main-stem water: USGS grab samples at Savannah (03593500) read 26.7-30.5 C in July-August samples (1967-1999), TWRA documents the reach's signature winter fishery as the SAUGER run (Dec-Mar, downstream side of TVA dams), and no trout stocking exists anywhere on the main stem.
